{{Quote|This is my farm. Yesterday, we had a dozen droids and fifteen workers collecting enough moisture for half of Anchorhead. Today, everything's gone. The pirates destroyed it. They took the droids, the harvesters. And when that wasn't enough... they took slaves. My daughter, every woman here, my neighbors' wives and kids. The pirates carried them off like livestock!|[[Danbar Hue]]|<ref name="TOR:SaR" />}}
The '''Chuaro Farmstead''' was a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:Goodwill" />
